extension_description.message: Save videos from X as MP4 and animated GIFs as GIF to your Downloads folder.

save_tooltip.message: Save videos in this post as MP4 and animated GIFs as GIF

keep_tab_open.message: Keep this tab open until saving is complete.

keep_popup_open.message: Downloading and converting. Keep this window open until saving is complete.

invalid_post_url.message: Enter a post URL in the form https://x.com/username/status/postID.

gif_options_load_failed.message: Could not load the default GIF settings.

gif_options_retry.message: $1 The default settings will be loaded again when you save.

post_unavailable.message: Could not retrieve the post. It may be deleted, private, or restricted, or X may have changed its service.

no_downloadable_media.message: No downloadable videos or animated GIFs were found. To save media in a quoted post, open the original post.

no_mp4_variant.message: Media item $1 has no downloadable MP4. Live streams and HLS are not supported.

no_video.message: This post has no videos or animated GIFs.

unsupported_media.message: This media layout is not supported.

extension_disconnected.message: The extension disconnected. Check Downloads for saved files, then reload the page. If the problem continues, quit and reopen Safari.

extension_result_timeout.message: The extension has not returned a save result. Check Downloads, then quit and reopen Safari.

native_unavailable.message: Could not connect to the saving service. Quit and reopen Safari, and make sure X Media Assist is enabled.

post_network_failed.message: Could not connect to the post service. Check your connection and the extension’s website permissions in Safari.

rate_limited.message: X’s request limit has been reached. Wait a while, then try again.

post_response_invalid.message: Could not read the response from X.

native_disconnected.message: The saving service disconnected. Check Downloads for saved files before trying again.

result_missing.message: Could not confirm the save result.

result_unknown.message: Could not confirm the save result. Check Downloads before trying again.

request_rejected.message: The save request could not be accepted.

save_busy.message: Saving is in progress. Wait for it to finish, then try again.

popup_disconnected.message: The extension disconnected. Check Downloads for saved files.

content_disconnected.message: The extension disconnected. Check Downloads, then reload the page.

native_invalid_response.message: The video server returned an invalid response.

native_too_large.message: The file exceeds the download size limit.

native_invalid_mp4.message: The downloaded file could not be verified as MP4.

native_write_failed.message: Could not save the file. Check free disk space and access to Downloads.

native_network.message: Could not download the video. Check your connection and try again.

gif_unsupported.message: Saved as MP4 because this video could not be converted to GIF.

gif_limit.message: Saved as MP4 because GIF conversion exceeded a file size, duration, resolution, or frame count limit.

gif_encoding.message: Saved as MP4 because the GIF could not be created or written.

gif_timeout.message: Saved as MP4 because GIF conversion exceeded the time limit.

gif_busy.message: Saved as MP4 because another GIF conversion is in progress.

gif_failed.message: Saved as MP4 because the GIF could not be created or saved.
